newsitem.title: USA: Nordstrom sees Q4 earnings below forecast.
newsitem.headline: Nordstrom sees Q4 earnings below forecast.

text.p: Nordstrom Inc said holiday season sales in stores open for more than one year declined moderately from last year, and that lower sales volume will result in earnings for the quarter ending January 31 being below those currently expected by analysts.
According to First Call, analysts had been forecasting Nordstrom to report fourth quarter earnings of $0.80 a share versus $0.67 a year ago.
John Goesling, Executive Vice President, said "the decline is attributable in part to fewer shopping days between Thanksgiving and Christmas."
